text:
marie_sales: FYI — Acme Bank wants an on‑prem pilot. Key asks: activation runbook, cert rotation cadence, bundle delivery (USB vs sidecar), and bandwidth estimate. They expect a ~3 week POC window. Can we confirm feasibility + a rough price for offline support?
chris_se: thanks — quick clarifying q: do they require full air‑gapped (no egress) or just restricted egress with proxy allowlist?
customer_it: @chris_se full air‑gapped. No outbound to our cloud. We can accept signed bundles via secure courier.
julie_ops: noted. For a sealed deployment we need: signed minibundles, a deterministic installer (sha256), root CA pinning, cert rotation runbook (preferably 6–12 mo), and an offline activation token workflow. Bandwidth for initial sync depends on model weight — estimate below.
chris_se: rough model sizes: small quantized runtime ~3.2GB, medium ~8GB, large variants 20+GB. Initial bundle + runtime + deps -> expect 12–30GB one‑time transfer depending on model choice. Delta patches can be <200MB typically.
marie_sales: customer asked about delta cadence — they want monthly security patches and quarterly model updates. Any constraints on us shipping monthly deltas by USB?
julie_ops: monthly deltas ok but we need a verified signing process and version matrix. Ops note: delta patch testing + hotfix window -> 2 business days for validation, then acceptance. If they want smaller cadence (weekly) we need SLA and paid validation run.
customer_it: also need answer on offline KMS/HSM support for key wrapping. Can you ship with customer HSM integration?
chris_se: we support KMS integration in Private (onprem) — offline envelope wrapping is doable but requires HSM cert exchange prior to delivery. We'll need the customer's signing public key and a short attestation protocol.
marie_sales: legal will push a security questionnaire. Julie, can you confirm the minimal answers we should give on upgrade cadence and rollback?
julie_ops: writeup (short):
- Upgrade cadence: monthly security deltas by default, opt‑in model updates quarterly.
- Rollback: deterministic immutable bundles + a validated rollback image; rollback tested on staging prior to courier deliver.
- Activation: time‑bound offline token (PKI signed) tied to installer SHA256.
Send these in the questionnaire and call out exceptions where they want faster cadences.
chris_se: implementation snippet for manifest we usually provide:```
manifest: 
  name: acme-poc
  version: 2026-03-01
  bundles:
    - runtime-quantized-v1.tar.gz
    - model-small-3.2GB.tar.gz
  signatures: [sha256:... ]
```
marie_sales: perfect. Also they asked about pricing for "offline support" — 1) bundling + signing fee, 2) courier handling, 3) validation per delta. Julie, ballpark?
julie_ops: ballpark (internal): bundling & signing $4k one‑time; courier handling depends on geography ~$300–$2k; validation per delta $700. If they want on‑site assistance for activation add day rate.
devops-bot: deploy-notify: staging bundle build 1750056801 succeeded (sha256: abc123...).
customer_it: thanks — can you add a short runbook we can hand to our NOC team? Stepwise activation + fallback say 8–10 steps?
chris_se: yes — I'll draft an 8‑step activation runbook (preflight checks, verify signature, install, health check, KV cache init, cert rotate test, smoke test, enable traffic). Will post tomorrow.
marie_sales: great — next actions: 1) chris draft runbook (by EOD PT tomorrow), 2) julie confirm signing process + final ballpark pricing, 3) marie send security questionnaire draft to client with our answers. If anyone sees blockers speak up now. :thumbsup:
julie_ops: no blockers from ops side, just need customer public signing key and confirmation of courier window.
customer_it: we'll share the public key today and confirm courier window next week. Thanks.
chris_se: noting dependencies: need customer's staging environment (k8s creds or VM access) for validation tests; if they can't provide staging we can run local validation but it'll affect SLAs.
marie_sales: noted. I'll include that in the handoff. Closing thread for now — will reopen if any new questions. :white_check_mark:
